concerns.text: The plan computes descriptor‑target Pearson correlations on the full dataset ("Descriptor‑Target Correlation: Pearson r & p‑value per descriptor; flag those with |r|>0.5 & p<0.01.") before any train/validation split. Using the entire dataset for feature relevance assessment can leak information from the test set into model training, inflating performance estimates. The analysis should be restricted to the training portion (or performed within cross‑validation folds) to avoid data‑leakage.
